profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Home Depot
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer living in Atlanta, Ga. I'm originally from Cluj-Napoca, Romania  and attended the Iuliu Hatieganu Medical School, where I majored in General Medicine. Upon graduation I entered an Epidemiology residency where I performed both patient care and research.After moving to the United States,I decided I was ready for a new challenge and followed my dream to learn to code. 
I attended Kennesaw State University and graduated Magna Cum Laude, with a Bachelor Degree in Computer Science in May 2018. During the spring semester of 2017,I discovered web development and I found my calling. I spent time between an overloaded course schedule and trying to teach myself web development concepts, but I found that it was a lot of trial and error. I don't take programming lightly and decided to dedicate myself 100% after graduation, to an environment that not only  pays attention to the theoretical concepts but also emphasis building applications to strengthen the expertise. So, in April of 2018,  I enrolled in DigitalCrafts'​ full-time immersive coding bootcamp where I am learning, building applications and having fun.

positions.title: Software Engineer Contracted at The Home Depot
positions.description: Software engineer contracted at The Home Depot through Modis.

positions.title: Resident Epidemiologist
positions.description:
Clinical Experience:
•	Performed examinations of patients, prescribed treatment courses based on diagnoses and conducted follow up examinations to assess the efficacy of the prescribed treatment
•	Delivered presentations on the prevention, control, and treatment of infectious diseases
•	Co-authored 4 retrospective analysis research and presented to the 9th and 10th National Infectious Disease Congress 
Laboratory Experience:
•	Collected biological samples and prepared them for examination
•	Conducted examinations of prepared samples
•	Assisted senior lab residents in the preparation of Ziehl-Neelsen stains for tuberculosis samples
•	Documented results of the examination of the findings
Public Health Department:
•	Conducted surveillance of seasonal diseases reported by regional medical entities
•	Investigated incidents of potential outbreaks of food borne diseases
•	Counseled newly documented HIV patients on treatment courses and preventative measures
•	Performed inspections of private medical practices to ensure compliance with legal norms
•	Performed inspections of public hospitals in search of cases of hospital acquired infections
•	Adhered to surveillance protocols for early detection and response to public health emergencies
•	Co-authored a study for presentation to the 10th National Infectious Disease Congress

company.name: Infectious Disease Hospital Cluj Napoca, Romania

positions.title: Part time Epidemiologist
positions.description:
Description: The Environmental Health Center (EHC) is one of the premier research facilities in eastern Europe in the field of environmental and occupational health. The EHC partners with public and private entities, in Romania as well as internationally, to conduct research studies related to the introduction of pollutants from various activities and the impact of those pollutants on the surrounding area and it’s population. 
Responsibilities:
•	Developed questionnaires and research tools for gathering data in environmental studies
•	Assisted in ongoing studies by performing related research
•	Collected and organized field data in preparation of statistical analysis
•	Performed descriptive statistics and regression analysis of collected data
•	Co-authored health impact assessments of studies related to exposure to toxic agents

projects.title: Bunker Labs Marketplace
projects.description:
Two weeks, team project for Bunker Labs Atlanta. Bunker Labs Marketplace represents an online platform that allows users to connect with veteran-owned businesses
Technologies used:
HTML5
 CSS3
React
Node.js
MongoDB
Express
 Robo3T/ MongoCompass 
Postman

projects.title: Movie Search Engine
projects.description:
Two day mini-React project that represents a tool for users to search a movie and obtain a carousel with the results
Technologies used: 
 React
 react-coverflow 
 OMDb API
